spec.alternative_hypothesis: On forward daily bars, the lag-1 BTC coefficient is larger in low-volatility regimes than in high-volatility regimes (positive interaction), and lag-1 BTC explains a positive component of next-day ETH returns within low-volatility rows.
spec.benchmark: Own-history baseline: next-day ETH return predicted from its own lagged return, the SOL common factor and lag-1 BTC, with the interaction excluded
cost_assumptions: OKX VIP0 taker fee 0.05% per side, from the OKX public fee schedule (okx.com/fees), checked 2026-11-18; treated as an assumption, not verified for the user's account
Funding rate costs ignored; perpetual funding can exceed taker fees over holding periods
Slippage and market impact ignored; both would reduce any edge
spec.cost_model: No cost gate in this version: the forward sample is too small for a walk-forward evaluation, so costs are not assessed until the sample supports it
exclusions: Unconfirmed (forming) OKX bars are excluded; only confirm=1 candles enter the panel
Rows without a regime label are excluded and counted
Rows with decision time before 2026-11-18T16:00Z are not in the test sample; earlier bars are used only to compute trailing regime labels
known_confounders: The hypothesis was generated from this pair's historical data; the forward sample is fresh but the pair is not
The 30-day volatility window and median-split regime rule mirror study 001's post-hoc descriptive split
The SOL common-factor proxy is itself driven by BTC and may absorb part of the transmission effect
The forward sample is small (minimum 60 low-volatility rows); the test has limited power against small effects
spec.mechanism: Same mechanism as H0002, applied to the original BTC→ETH pair on strictly forward data: in low-volatility regimes, orderly price discovery lets information repriced in BTC transmit to ETH with a lag.
spec.missing_data_policy: No forward filling; drop incomplete synchronized rows and report the dropped count; rows without a regime label (warm-up) are excluded and counted
model_definition: Interaction OLS with HAC standard errors (forward daily BTC→ETH)
Low-volatility-subsample partial lead-lag with HAC standard errors
spec.multiple_testing_family: Forward low-volatility BTC→ETH daily transmission (2 tests: interaction, low-volatility subsample)
spec.null_hypothesis: On forward daily bars, lag-1 BTC returns have no regime-dependent incremental predictive value for next-day ETH returns beyond ETH's own history and the common-factor control.
spec.primary_metric: Partial R-squared of the BTC×lowvol interaction in the forward BTC→ETH interaction regression
rejection_criteria: Holm-adjusted interaction p-value at or above 0.05
spec.research_question: On daily bars observed after the preregistration date, does lag-1 BTC perpetual return predict next-day ETH perpetual return more strongly in low-volatility regimes than in high-volatility regimes?
spec.target_definition: Next-day close-to-close ETH-USDT perpetual log return on bars after 2026-11-18T16:00Z
spec.title: Low-volatility BTC→ETH transmission (forward test)
